description: Every admissible inference directly between the two displayed barber clauses whose selected positive and negative families each have one member has a tautological conclusion: it contains some actual atom and its negation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.barber_single_pair_tautological.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (B : L.Relations 2) (a : L.Functions 0)
  (d :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.InferenceData (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.barberC B a)
      (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.barberD B a))
  (hS : Finset.card d.positiveFamily = 1) (hT : Finset.card d.negativeFamily = 1) :
  ∃ A,
    Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.signed true A ∈
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d ∧
      Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.signed false A ∈
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d
